text: 管涛：全球央行加息未竟但约束重重 在通胀上行风险较为突出的背景下，主要央行加息进程有望延续，但是否会形成新一轮的紧缩周期仍有待观察。
text_en: Guan Tao: Global central bank rate hikes are unfinished but face many constraints. Against the backdrop of relatively prominent upside inflation risks, the rate hike process of major central banks is expected to continue, but whether it will form a new round of tightening cycles remains to be seen.
